paragraphs:
Sabrina Suppa is an artist and designer specialised in digital modelling. 
Her practice explores the body as a site of forced evolution, creating forms that appear organic yet are shaped by technical precision. 
Grounded in photorealism, her practice begins with the close observation and reconstruction of natural forms, which she then alters through technology to trace their transition from realism into abstraction.

In 2025, she began extending her digital practice into 3D printing and physical fabrication, developing architectures that reshape the human silhouette through a post-human lens. 
Influenced by her studies in classical piano and interior design, she translates rhythm, structure, and geometric abstraction into sculptural forms.

She has been working as a character and creature artist in international studios within the film and gaming industry such as DNEG, Framestore, MPC and Ninja Theory where she cultivated her fascination with anatomical studies and the expressive potential of the human body.
